notes: Manufacturer spec page (tascam.com) used as primary source; cross-checked against the Tascam product overview page (tascam.com/us/product/portacapture_x8/top), which corroborated all connector counts and types. Unit is handheld/desktop, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Power: also runs on 4x AA batteries (no discrete connector) or USB bus power via the USB-C port — only the optional AC adapter jack is listed as a port; its exact barrel dimensions are not published, so dc-barrel is inferred (closest match in the allowed list). Two additional physical connectors exist but were omitted because they have no id in the allowed connector list: a proprietary Bluetooth-adapter port (for the optional AK-BT1 dongle) and a cold-shoe/tripod mechanical mount (non-signal). microSD card slot (up to 512GB) also omitted as it is storage media, not a cabled I/O connector. B&H's spec page returned HTTP 403 and could not be used as a secondary retailer cross-check, but the two manufacturer pages agree, so confidence remains high.
